title: Every Golden Boy winner, by age
checked: All 23 winners 2003-2025 with age at the award from Wikipedia's table; the youngest-winner record line (Van der Vaart 20y304d, Rooney 19y50d, Messi 18y173d, Gavi 18y77d, Yamal 17y137d) from the same table and its text; Yamal's 17y137d also in futbolupdate's table and matches his birth date (13 July 2007, award 27 Nov 2024). Count by age: 17 = 1, 18 = 4, 19 = 6, 20 = 12. Four of the five youngest from Barcelona (Yamal, Gavi, Messi, Pedri; Mbappe Monaco). Doue 2025 winner at 20 (Flashscore, The Star). Yamal the Euros' youngest scorer at 16 v France, Munich, 9 July 2024, Spain 2-1 (Sky Sports, NBC); Spain won Euro 2024 before his Golden Boy. Doue scored twice in PSG 5-0 Inter, 31 May 2025 (UEFA, Wikipedia). No 2026 winner yet (announced in November), so left out.

lines.text: The Golden Boy goes to Europe's best player under twenty-one. And the winners keep getting younger.
lines.say: The Golden Boy goes to Europe's best player under twenty-one. And the winners keep getting younger.

lines.text: It began in twenty oh three, with Rafael van der Vaart of Ajax. Twenty years and three hundred and four days.
lines.say: It began in twenty oh three, with Rahfahel fan der Vart of Eyeax. Twenty years and three hundred and four days.

lines.text: Twenty-two winners later, he's still the oldest. Most winners are twenty, and nobody since has been older.
lines.say: Twenty-two winners later, he's still the oldest. Most winners are twenty, and nobody since has been older.

lines.text: Then the record for the youngest started to fall. Rooney at nineteen. Then an eighteen-year-old from Barcelona: Lionel Messi.
lines.say: Then the record for the youngest started to fall. Rooney at nineteen. Then an eighteen-year-old from Barcelona: Leeonel Messee.

scene.title: The youngest winner, record by record

lines.text: Messi's record lasted seventeen years. Then came another kid from the Barcelona academy, Gavi.
lines.say: Messee's record lasted seventeen years. Then came another kid from the Barcelona academy, Gahvee.

lines.text: Two summers later, Lamine Yamal was sixteen. In a Euros semi-final against France, he scored a screamer.
lines.say: Two summers later, Lahmeen Yahmahl was sixteen. In a Yooros semifinal against France, he scored a screamer.

scene.headline: Yamal, 16, becomes the Euros' youngest scorer
scene.standfirst: His long-range equaliser in Munich turns the semi-final, and Spain beat France 2-1 to reach the final.

lines.text: Spain won the Euros. And that November, Yamal took the Golden Boy at seventeen.
lines.say: Spain won the Yooros. And that November, Yahmahl took the Golden Boy at seventeen.

lines.text: Four of the five youngest winners came from Barcelona. The other one was Kylian Mbappé.
lines.say: Four of the five youngest winners came from Barcelona. The other one was Keeleean Embapay.

lines.text: Pedri missed being nineteen by three days.
lines.say: Pedree missed being nineteen by three days.

lines.text: And the winners don't fade. Messi, Mbappé, Haaland and Bellingham all became world stars.
lines.say: And the winners don't fade. Messee, Embapay, Hohland and Bellingham all became world stars.

lines.text: Last year's winner, Désiré Doué, was twenty. He'd scored twice in a Champions League final.
lines.say: Last year's winner, Dehzeeray Dooay, was twenty. He'd scored twice in a Champions League final.

lines.text: So the record is seventeen years, a hundred and thirty-seven days. Can anyone go younger?
lines.say: So the record is seventeen years, a hundred and thirty-seven days. Can anyone go younger?

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
